about.description:
wdfkit is a Python toolkit for Renishaw WiRE .wdf spectroscopy data,
especially Raman and photoluminescence work. It reads single spectra,
line scans, depth/time series, point collections, and raster maps into
xarray.DataArray objects with consistent, predictable dimension names:
the spectral axis is always "spectral"; maps always use
("row", "column", "spectral"); series and point collections always use
("point", "spectral"). Spatial and temporal coordinates from the
instrument's ORGN metadata, together with acquisition parameters and
calibration, are attached automatically as coordinates and attrs.
A header-only catalog() scan inventories whole directories of .wdf
files without loading spectral data.
about.summary: Python package for WDF data treatment

name: wdfkit
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.1.4"
  python_min: "3.12"

package:
  name: wdfkit
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/w/wdfkit/wdfkit-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: fb5ce62289d6b8ef32a784ede170467a9744feb7203d4919fa4744caed5d3768

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - wdfkit = wdfkit.wdfkit_app:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
    - setuptools-git-versioning >=2.0
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy
    - pandas
    - xarray
    - pillow
    - dask-core
    - psutil

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - wdfkit
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - wdfkit --version
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/svi-lab/wdfkit/
  summary: Python package for WDF data treatment
  description: |
    wdfkit is a Python toolkit for Renishaw WiRE .wdf spectroscopy data,
    especially Raman and photoluminescence work. It reads single spectra,
    line scans, depth/time series, point collections, and raster maps into
    xarray.DataArray objects with consistent, predictable dimension names:
    the spectral axis is always "spectral"; maps always use
    ("row", "column", "spectral"); series and point collections always use
    ("point", "spectral"). Spatial and temporal coordinates from the
    instrument's ORGN metadata, together with acquisition parameters and
    calibration, are attached automatically as coordinates and attrs.
    A header-only catalog() scan inventories whole directories of .wdf
    files without loading spectral data.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.rst
  documentation: https://svi-lab.github.io/wdfkit
  repository: https://github.com/svi-lab/wdfkit/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - dshirya
